_note: Balance targets for sim/run.mjs. win: [min, max] win rate in percent for each bot, by scenario difficulty. The kid targets for difficulty 3 are higher than a first-time player would get, because those scenarios unlock only after wins. days: [min, max] median day of a win for the smart bot (1.5 s per day at speed 1). spread: max gap in points between the best and the worst product for the smart bot in one scenario. rushBelowSmart: the rush bot (no defense) should win at least this many points less than the smart bot. It is a warning only, because TrendLab is beaten with growth upgrades.
